info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Sanidine Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Sanidine Produce Catalog Management API facilitates the submission of detailed entries for Sanidine produce within the catalog. This endpoint allows users to create well-defined records that include essential product information and specifications. Typically utilized by inventory managers and product developers, this API streamlines the process of enriching the catalog and ensures accurate representation of Sanidine produce. By enabling structured product data submissions, it supports improved inventory tracking and marketing efforts.

post.summary: Creates new details for sanidine produce.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit new details related to sanidine produce. It accepts the necessary data in the request body and processes it to store the information for future reference.

requestBody.description: A JSON object containing the details required for producing sanidine. This includes all necessary parameters for processing the production request.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and details are returned.
